The small 0.16% non-compliant income triggers a purification rate if dividends are received. Mizan’s result is a screening, not a fatwa, so investors should consider both methodologies.

MSCI Islamic Index screen fails: total debt-to-assets ratio 60.23% exceeds the 33.33% limit.
Non-compliant income is 0.16% of total revenue, defining a purification rate of 0.16% for dividends.
